// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX matmul kernel (128x128x256, fp6:e3m2).
void solution(void) {
  {
    int ti = MATMUL_M / DIM / 2, tj = MATMUL_N / DIM / 2, tk = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    uint32_t ab = 0;
    // Fix B base address calculation to properly account for the scratchpad layout
    uint32_t bb = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tk * tj * DIM;
    int SDST = 0; // Use address 0 for output in accumulator

    // 1. Configure execution and MX formats (FP6 path)
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 1, 1, 3, 1);

    // 2. Load scale factors for both A and B
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_row, sizeof(A_scales_row), 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_col, sizeof(B_scales_col), 1);

    // 3. Load FP6 dequantization LUTs
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)B_lut_p, 1, 0); // B weight LUT
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)A_lut_p, 1, 1); // A activation LUT

    // 4. Batched and Unrolled MVIN for Matrix A (loading 2x16 tiles at a time)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < ti; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * 2 * DIM * MATMUL_K + k * DIM), 
                             ab + (i * tk + k) * DIM * 2, 
                             DIM, 2 * DIM);
      }
    }

    // 5. Batched and Unrolled MVIN for Matrix B (loading 2x16 tiles at a time)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t)); // Correct stride for full N dimension
    for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < tj; j++) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + k * DIM * MATMUL_N + j * 2 * DIM), 
                              bb + (j * tk + k) * DIM * 2, 
                              DIM, 2 * DIM);
      }
    }

    // 6. Configure output and requantization with optimized granularity
    gemmini_config_st(OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
    gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, ti * 2, tj * 2, tk, 0, 0, tk);

    // 7. Perform Weight-Stationary compute via hardware fused loop
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(ti * 2, tj * 2, tk, 0, 0, 0, ab, bb, 0, SDST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

    // 8. Drain results to DRAM
    gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[0][0], SDST, MATMUL_M * MATMUL_N);

    // 9. Fence to guarantee pipeline completion
    gemmini_fence();
  }
}
